SELECT to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS checked_at_ist,(SELECT count(*) FROM mrp_price_history) AS mrp_count,(SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to(coalesce(string_agg(row_text,E'
' ORDER BY row_text COLLATE "C"),''),'UTF8')),'hex') FROM (SELECT jsonb_build_array(item_code,to_char(effective_date,'YYYY-MM-DD'),variant,encode(float8send(mrp),'hex'),encode(float8send(net_price),'hex'),encode(float8send(discount_pct),'hex'),price_basis)::text AS row_text FROM mrp_price_history) v) AS mrp_value_sha256,(SELECT count(*) FROM catalog_products) AS catalogue_count,(SELECT md5(string_agg(row_to_json(p)::text,'|' ORDER BY id)) FROM catalog_products p) AS catalogue_full_md5,(SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to(coalesce(string_agg(jsonb_build_array(item_code,category,series_range,division)::text,E'
' ORDER BY item_code COLLATE "C"),''),'UTF8')),'hex') FROM catalog_products) AS classification_sha256
sql.currentScopes: WITH clock AS (SELECT to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS observed_ist,(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AS as_of), current_rows AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (competitor,matched_prayag_code) competitor,matched_prayag_code,price FROM competitor_prices,clock WHERE matched_prayag_code IS NOT NULL AND match_status='matched' AND effective_date IS NOT NULL AND effective_date<=as_of AND price IS NOT NULL ORDER BY competitor,matched_prayag_code,effective_date DESC,id DESC), scopes AS (SELECT c.competitor,p.division,p.category,count(*)::int AS current_positive_price_rows FROM current_rows c JOIN catalog_products p ON regexp_replace(upper(regexp_replace(trim(c.matched_prayag_code),'\s+','','g')),'\.0$','')=regexp_replace(upper(regexp_replace(trim(p.item_code),'\s+','','g')),'\.0$',''),clock WHERE c.price>0 AND p.is_active=TRUE AND (p.discontinued_from IS NULL OR p.discontinued_from>as_of) GROUP BY c.competitor,p.division,p.category) SELECT clock.observed_ist,coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(scopes) ORDER BY competitor,division,category),'[]'::jsonb) AS scopes FROM clock LEFT JOIN scopes ON TRUE GROUP BY clock.observed_ist
